title: Marine Engine Cover 420D – Universal Protection
descriptionHtml:
Protect the engine in all weather

An unprotected marine engine is constantly exposed to sun, rain and salt. That makes it age faster and lose its value.

All-weather protection in 420D fabric

The engine cover is made of heavy-duty 420D Oxford fabric that gives good protection all year round. It fits most marine engines and sits securely in place.

Features

  • Heavy-duty 420D Oxford fabric
  • All-weather protection against sun, rain and salt
  • Fits marine engines from 6 to 250 hp
  • Available in several colors
  • Sits securely and is easy to take off

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
